My memory doesn't hold anything the owner said about secret detection, redaction in summaries, or rotation prompts as features, so I can't quote him on that, and I won't guess.

What I do have is narrower. He once pasted his sudo password into the chat, and it was used once, for the inotify sysctl. I told him to rotate it. The standing rule I carry forward is to never store or reuse it, and not to repeat it, including in summaries. That is a rule about that one incident, not a request for tooling.

Whether to build detection or redaction is his product call, so I'd ask it through AskUserQuestion rather than decide it myself.
